## PCA Image Compression App

This image compression application will allow users to upload an image and check how different levels of PCA compression would impact its appearance. Users will be able to select the number of principal components on a sliding scale and then compare the compressed image with the original image side-by-side below the scale.

<div style="border: 2px solid #cccccc; border-radius: 12px; padding: 25px; margin-top: 25px; background-color: #fafafa;">
